title: Why Your Boss Will Be an AI by 2028
full_monologue: **By 2028, your boss might just be an AI.** Think about it—AI is already handling tasks like scheduling, data analysis, and even customer service. As technology evolves, AI will become more intuitive, more human-like, and more capable of leading teams. Companies will prioritize efficiency, and AI won’t just assist—AI will decide. It’s not sci-fi; it’s the future. So, what will your job look like when AI is calling the shots? Comment below.
